_comment: Copy the 'fix-spec-search' block into your MCP client config (Claude Desktop: claude_desktop_config.json; Claude Code: .mcp.json at the repo root). Adjust the absolute path to server.py. On macOS/Linux use forward slashes. No docs path is needed — the corpus is bundled under docs/. To point it at a different corpus instead, add  "env": { "FIX_SPEC_DOCS": "C:\\path\\to\\docs" }.
